Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
-- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
declare
 t_plasma_count number := 0;
begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.plasma_file_type is not null then
 begin
 select count(*)
 into t_plasma_count
 from vserv_master
 where code_type = 'PLFIL'
 and code = :ctrl_blk_1.plasma_file_type
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate)
 between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10);
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if t_plasma_count = 0 then
 show_error_dist('1521');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 else
 show_error_dist('0204'); 
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;
-- End of change

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
-- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count = 'N' then 
 :Global.Error_count := 'Y';
 if error_code in (50002, 50003, 50004, -- invalid date
 50011, 50012, 50021, 50023, 50025, 50026, 0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK), 1, 2)) = 'FX' then
 disp_format_mask := substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK), 3);
 else
 disp_format_mask := get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 :global.error_occurred := 'Y';
 show_error_dist('0022', disp_format_mask);
 check_package_failure;
 elsif error_code in (50017, 50018, 50019, 50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error_dist('0331');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;
-- End of change

check_package_failure;
-- End of commented section */

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_LOG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
Procedure retrieve_log is
 -- this procedure retrieve data from the xmlerrlog file
 szXMLDir VARCHAR2(20);
 szLogFile VARCHAR2(30);
 in_file TEXT_IO.file_type;
 lineBuf VARCHAR2(90);
 getDate VARCHAR2(20);
BEGIN
 if :ctrl_blk_1.plasma_file_type = 'XML' then -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 ---Get the Directory from the Master code table
 Begin
 Select code_desc 
 into szXMLDir 
 from vserv_master 
 where code_type = 'XMLDR' 
 and code = 'XMLDR' 
 --and rownum =1; -- Commented by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate)
 between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10); -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 Exception
 When No_data_found then
 message('Error Log directory was not found');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 End;
 
 --- Open the file with the read mode 
 szLogFile:=szXMLDir||'/XMLERRLOG.log';
 elsif :ctrl_blk_1.plasma_file_type = 'CSL' then -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 begin
 select code_desc 
 into szXMLDir 
 from vserv_master 
 where code_type = 'CSLFL' 
 and code = 'CSLER' 
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate)
 between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 message('Error Log directory was not found');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 
 szLogFile := szXMLDir || '/CSLERRLOG.log';
 -- End of change
 end if; -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 
 in_file := Text_IO.Fopen(szLogFile, 'r');
 
 Go_BLOCK('ERROR_LOG');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 first_record;
 
 Begin
 Loop
 TEXT_IO.Get_Line(in_file, lineBuf);
 If :ctrl_blk_1.log_date is not null then
 getDate:=substr(lineBuf,1,8);
 if getDate = to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.log_date,'mm-dd-yy') then
 :Error_log.log_desc:=lineBuf;
 next_record;
 end if;
 Else
 :Error_log.log_desc:=lineBuf;
 next_record; -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 End if;
 End Loop;
 
 Exception 
 When no_data_found then
 TEXT_IO.FCLOSE(in_file) ;
 End;
 
 first_record;
 if :error_log.log_desc is null then
 --go_item('ctrl_blk_1.log_date'); -- Commented by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 --message('No log found for date entered'); -- Commented by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1'); -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 clear_block; -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 message('No log found for Plasma File Type and the date entered'); -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

EXCEPTION 
 WHEN others 
 THEN
 IF NOT Text_IO.Is_Open(in_file) THEN
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1'); -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 clear_block; -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 message('Error : Log file not found!');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1'); -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 clear_block; -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 Text_IO.Fclose (in_file); 
 message('Error:'||sqlerrm);pause; 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

END;
